description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmployeeDirectoryDao' for interacting with the employee directory database. It includes methods to retrieve employee lists, count employees, and fetch employee details by employee number, based on search filters.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for retrieving employee data from the database with search filters, counting employees, and fetching employee records by employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper object with applied filters and joins for fetching employee data.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of employees matching the search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches a single Employee entity by its employee number.
